title: simrun: a runner of simulation workflows on a k3s cluster

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-University Berlin, Faculty of Life Science, Institute for Biology, Biology, Berlin; University Lübeck; University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein, Campus Lübeck, First Department of Medicine, Germany
creators.name: König, Matthias

description:
simrun is a runner of simulation workflows on a small k3s cluster with Argo Workflows and Kueue, with source code available from https://github.com/matthiaskoenig/simrun

Features include among others

  • workflows of tasks in YAML, task types from plugins, submitted with the working trees of the model and the libraries
  • split tasks whose units spread over the idle servers and are taken back by runs of higher priority
  • the memory of the pods learned from earlier runs
  • a command line, an HTTP API and an MCP server for people and agents

The documentation is available on https://matthiaskoenig.github.io/simrun

If you have any questions or issues please open an issue
